scope: Current Xenoverse 2 provenance/mechanics promotion for the next four verified frontier skills

records.name: Recoome Kick
records.mechanics: Fast single-hit flying knee/side-kick rush; on a successful hit, the user's normal/basic attack power is temporarily increased. Current skill documentation lists 10% damage.
limits: Exact attack-buff magnitude/duration and individual reward probability remain unresolved.
The repository does not infer a hidden Ultimate-Finish-only gate because maintained PQ61 evidence places Recoome Kick in Basic Reward.

records.name: Sauzer Blade
records.mechanics: Creates a Ki blade and performs five tracking slashes; current skill documentation records about 10% total damage and notes the blade cancels weak Ki Blasts.
limits: No narrower CaC race/gender/form restriction is inferred from Jeice's character association.

records.name: Savory Slicer
records.mechanics: Forms Ki blades on both hands and spins toward the opponent; current skill documentation records nine hits, about 20% damage, and resistance to weak Ki Blasts while charging forward.
limits: The accessible current quest page lists Savory Slicer among rewards but does not itself expose the exact reward-slot probability; the repository's maintained reward normalization retains the Ultimate-Finish bonus-slot route.

records.name: Scissors Paper Rock
records.mechanics: Three selectable short-range branches: Rock performs a strike, Scissors blinds the opponent, and Paper knocks the target away; combining all three produces a three-hit sequence.
limits: No Ultimate-Finish-only gate is inferred from maintained PQ65 reward evidence.

evidence_boundary: Batch 343 promotes four live verified/verified skills using current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence. Existing reward uncertainty is preserved; no numeric drop probabilities are invented.
